report_hints: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
Humans developed a bioweapon to exterminate the remaining aliens
Alien survivors launched a counterattack against human bases
Sympathetic humans coordinated an escape plan to aid the aliens
Military leaders negotiated a peace treaty with alien elders
Scientists discovered a way to reverse the environmental damage
Alien refugees infiltrated the lab to sabotage human technology
The question asks for an explanation of events in a missing interval, which is a temporal/causal inference not directly visible in single frames
Option E (environmental damage reversal) lacks specific visual cues distinct from general science/lab scenes without more context
Option F (infiltration/sabotage) involves stealth and destruction that might look similar to combat or accidents; verify intent via narrative context
Distinguish between negotiation (peace), conflict (war/bioweapon), and cooperation (escape) based on body language and environmental state
